composites.name: island_archipelago
composites.description: Lotka-Volterra island biogeography: a mainland + smaller distant islands, each with discrete LV population dynamics, coupled by distance-stochastic inter-island migration and random species introduction.

n_species.description: Size of the global species pool

interaction_weight.description: Spread of the random interaction matrix

introduction_probability.description: Per-island per-generation chance of a new-species introduction

seed.description: RNG seed for reproducible stochastic dynamics

composites.name: island_food_web
composites.description: Food-web island biogeography: identical archipelago topology, but species interactions come from a random trophic food web (producers/primary/secondary consumers) with antisymmetric predator-prey couplings.

n_species.description: Size of the global species pool

introduction_probability.description: Per-island per-generation chance of a new-species introduction

seed.description: RNG seed for reproducible food web + dynamics

composites.name: mw_equilibrium
composites.description: Canonical MacArthur-Wilson equilibrium model: independent islands drawing from a mainland species pool, each relaxing to S* set by area (extinction) and isolation (colonization). One run yields the rate-crossing equilibrium, the species-area power law, and turnover.

extinction_base.description: Per-species extinction prob at the reference (largest) area

area_max.description: Largest island area (= reference area for extinction)

distance_min.description: Least isolated island distance (linear across islands)

distance_max.description: Most isolated island distance (0 = isolation held fixed)

area_exponent.description: Area-extinction exponent; sets the species-area slope z

seed.description: RNG seed; each island uses seed + its index

composites.name: microbial_island
composites.description: MacArthur-Wilson equilibrium model in a microbial regime: a large mainland taxa pool, fast colonization + extinction (high turnover), and a shallow area-extinction exponent giving the observed flat microbial taxa-area slope (z ~ 0.02-0.1; Horner-Devine 2004, Bell 2005). Reuses MacArthurWilsonEquilibriumProcess with no new process.

n_pool.description: Mainland taxa-pool size P (large for microbes)

colonization_base.description: Per-taxon colonization prob at distance 0 (fast dispersal)

extinction_base.description: Per-taxon extinction prob at the reference area (fast local turnover)

area_max.description: Largest patch area (= reference area for extinction)

distance_min.description: Least isolated patch distance (linear across islands)

distance_max.description: Most isolated patch distance (0 = isolation held fixed)

area_exponent.description: Area-extinction exponent; low -> flat microbial taxa-area slope z

seed.description: RNG seed; each island uses seed + its index

composites.name: general_dynamic_model
composites.description: General Dynamic Model of oceanic island biogeography (Whittaker, Triantis & Ladle 2008): a few islands with time-varying area (ontogeny) staggered along a t_peak age gradient. Each island grows then erodes, so species richness overshoots and then declines — a humped trajectory the static MacArthur-Wilson equilibrium cannot produce.

extinction_base.description: Per-species extinction prob at the reference (max) area

ontogeny_shape.description: Sharpness of the area hump (>1 sharpens)

ref_area.description: Area at which extinction equals extinction_base

interval.description: Model-time units per tick (discrete model: keep 1.0)

seed.description: RNG seed; each island uses seed + its index

composites.name: rescue_effect
composites.description: Brown & Kodric-Brown (1977) rescue-effect archipelago: identical islands (same area and isolation) differing only in how strongly incoming propagules rescue present species from extinction. Coupling the immigration and extinction curves raises equilibrium richness and damps turnover; rescue_strength=0 reduces to the independent-curves MacArthur-Wilson equilibrium.

n_islands.description: Number of islands (rescue-strength levels, or replicates)

colonization_base.description: Per-species colonization prob at distance 0 (also the rescue probability)

extinction_base.description: Per-species baseline extinction prob at the reference area

rescue_min.description: Rescue strength on the first island (0 = no rescue = baseline M-W)

rescue_max.description: Rescue strength on the last island (linear across islands)

seed.description: RNG seed; each island uses seed + its index

composites.name: neutral_metacommunity
composites.description: Hubbell (2001) zero-sum neutral metacommunity: independent fixed-J islands over an area gradient, each evolving by Moran dispersal-drift from a shared species pool. Richness and the species-abundance distribution emerge with no niche differences and no colonization/extinction rate asymmetry — the neutral counterpoint to MacArthur-Wilson.

density.description: Individuals per unit area (sets local size J = area*density)

immigration_base.description: Per-replacement immigration probability m at distance 0

distance_min.description: Least isolated island distance (linear across islands)

distance_max.description: Most isolated island distance (0 = isolation held fixed)

seed.description: RNG seed; each island uses seed + its index
